description:
Job Family : 
SAAS/PAAS/Cloud Application Development 
 Travel Required : 
Up to 10% 
 Clearance Required : 
Ability to Obtain Secret 
 
 What You Will Do: 
 As a Salesforce Developer, you will play a critical role in architecting, developing, and supporting enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions for Guidehouse clients. You will work alongside Solution Architects, Technical Leads, Product Owners, and client stakeholders to transform business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.
 This role combines hands-on development with modern engineering practices, requiring expertise across the Salesforce platform, integration architecture, DevOps, and enterprise application development.
 The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical depth, consulting acumen, and a passion for delivering innovative Salesforce solutions that drive measurable client value.

 Responsibilities:

 Salesforce Application Development
 Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions across the Salesforce platform.
 Build custom applications utilizing Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, Aura Components, and Salesforce Flows.
 Develop reusable frameworks, components, and services that improve development efficiency and solution maintainability.
 Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical designs and production-ready solutions.
 Develop high-quality, well-tested code that aligns with Salesforce and enterprise development standards.
 Salesforce Platform Engineering & Architecture
 Design and optimize Salesforce data models, platform architecture, and application frameworks.
 Develop scalable solutions supporting Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, Public Sector Solutions, and Industry Clouds.
 Implement platform security using profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, security controls, and governance best practices.
 Leverage asynchronous processing patterns including Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, Platform Events, and Scheduled Jobs.
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and performance challenges.
 Integration & Enterprise Solution Development
 Design and implement integrations utilizing REST APIs, SOAP services, Platform Events, and middleware technologies.
 Build API-led architectures that connect Salesforce with enterprise systems and external applications.
 Support data migration, transformation, data quality, and data synchronization initiatives.
 Develop event-driven architectures and scalable integration patterns that support enterprise growth.
 Collaborate with integration architects and enterprise architects to ensure solution alignment with long-term business objectives.
 Engineering Excellence & Innovation
 Contribute to DevSecOps initiatives, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management processes.
 Participate in code reviews and establish engineering best practices across project teams.
 Evaluate and implement emerging Salesforce capabilities and platform innovations.
 Explore opportunities to leverage Agentforce, Einstein AI, Data Cloud, and AI-powered automation capabilities where appropriate.
 Utilize AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery acceleration.
 Client Consulting & Collaboration
 Participate in technical discovery workshops and solution design sessions.
 Partner with business analysts, architects, and client stakeholders to align technical solutions with business objectives.
 Communicate technical approaches, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Mentor junior developers and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
 Support proposal development, solutioning efforts, and innovation initiatives across the Salesforce practice.
 
 What You Will Need: 

 Minimum of FIVE (5) years of Salesforce development experience.
 Demonstrated expertise developing solutions using: Apex
 Lightning Web Components (LWC)
 Salesforce Flows
 Aura Components
 Visualforce
 
 Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture and development best practices.
 Experience designing scalable Salesforce data models and working with relational databases.
 Experience supporting Experience Cloud implementations and customer-facing digital experiences.
 Expertise designing and implementing integrations utilizing REST and SOAP APIs.
 Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
 Experience implementing asynchronous processing solutions including: Batch Apex
 Queueable Apex
 Future Methods
 Platform Events
 
 Knowledge of Salesforce security architecture, governance, and secure coding practices.
 Experience troubleshooting performance, scalability, and application reliability issues.
 Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based source control, DevOps methodologies, and release management processes.
 Strong experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
 Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
 Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
 US Citizenship is contractually required. Must be able to obtain a Secret clearance.
 
 What Would Be Nice to Have: 

 Salesforce Platform Developer I Certification.
 Salesforce Platform Developer II Certification.
 Salesforce Administrator Certification.
 Salesforce App Builder Certification.
 Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect credentials.
 Experience with Public Sector Solutions, Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, Communications Cloud, or Education Cloud.
 Experience supporting Federal Civilian, Defense, State & Local Government, Healthcare, or Commercial clients.
 Experience with MuleSoft, AWS, Azure, Databricks, or enterprise integration platforms.
 Exposure to: Agentforce
 Einstein AI
 Data Cloud
 Prompt Builder
 Generative AI technologies
 
 Experience with AI-assisted development tools and intelligent automation platforms.
 Additional Salesforce certifications or willingness to obtain certifications.
 


 
 
The annual salary range for this position is $92,000.00-$153,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 
 What We Offer: 
 Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
 
 Benefits include:
 Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

 Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

 Parental Leave

 401(k) Retirement Plan

 Group Term Life and Travel Assistance

 Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance

 Health Savings Account, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

 Transit and Parking Commuter Benefits

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development, Certifications & Learning Opportunities

 Employee Referral Program

 Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach

 Care.com annual membership

 Employee Assistance Program

 Supplemental Benefits via Corestream (Critical Care, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Legal Assistance and ID theft protection, etc.)

 Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus

 
 About Guidehouse 
 Guidehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer–Protected Veterans, Individuals with Disabilities or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.
 
 Guidehouse will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable law or ordinance including the Fair Chance Ordinance of Los Angeles and San Francisco.
 
 If you have visited our website for information about employment opportunities, or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Guidehouse Recruiting at 1-571-633-1711 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@guidehouse.com . All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodation.
 
 All communication regarding recruitment for a Guidehouse position will be sent from Guidehouse email domains including @guidehouse.com or guidehouse@myworkday.com .  Correspondence received by an applicant from any other domain should be considered unauthorized and will not be honored by Guidehouse.  Note that Guidehouse will never charge a fee or require a money transfer at any stage of the recruitment process and does not collect fees from educational institutions for participation in a recruitment event. Never provide your banking information to a third party purporting to need that information to proceed in the hiring process.
 
 If any person or organization demands money related to a job opportunity with Guidehouse, please report the matter to Guidehouse’s Ethics Hotline. If you want to check the validity of correspondence you have received, please contact recruiting@guidehouse.com . Guidehouse is not responsible for losses incurred (monetary or otherwise) from an applicant’s dealings with unauthorized third parties.
 
 Guidehouse does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Guidehouse and Guidehouse will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.
